QuestInfo.0: Protective Mask wants to speak with you.
QuestInfo.1: Not having a mask on in this place is risky. Gray Mask will make you a mask if you go and gather materials for it. \r\n\r\nGo to Outlaw's Street 1 and get 20 Cheap Mask Materials.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered the mask materials, but Gray Mask made a mistake.

3.msg: Heh, looks like I need to make a mask so you can fit in.

5.msg: Do you HAVE to wear clothes? Stop nitpicking and get the materials. You'll find plenty of bag masks this way...

6.msg: A bunch of hoodlums, those ones. You'll have to teach them a lesson and take what they've gathered.

0.msg: You can gather the materials by teaching the #bPaper Bag Alley Citizens#k in #bOutlaw's Street 1#k a lesson.

1.0: I think this is enough. Wait here and I'll have the mask ready in no time.

yes.0: Huh? Oh, no! I messed it up...

npc.0: Gather 20 #t4034979# items and take them to #p3003209# who will make a mask for you.

item.0: I need 20 #t4034979# items to make the mask.
